caption: The drawing depicts a black metal object consisting of a coiled spring-like central structure with two symmetrical curled ends extending horizontally from opposite sides near the top. The central coiled column sits above a flat, circular disk which serves as a base. Three straight legs emerge downward and outward from underneath the circular disk, each terminating in an upward-facing, hooked foot. The entire object is rendered in shades of dark gray to black, with subtle highlights and shadows that suggest a metallic surface. The background is a plain light beige color, and there are no other objects or details present in the image.
title: Spiral Candlestick
